brand_law.ochre_usage: Warnings, uncertainty, stops, and abstention only; never decorative.
brand_law.style: Editorial scientific minimalism on warm paper; calm, precise, evidence-first, premium, and society-facing before atom-facing.
forbidden: baked text, letters, numbers, labels, or logos in generated imagery
people or faces
flowers or plants
neon or dark backgrounds
glowing circuits or stock 3D-render aesthetics
molecule-as-hero imagery
unsupported before-and-after transformations
visual or verbal overclaims
brand_law.composition_text_rule: Editorial titles, captions, figures, and citations may be added only as deterministic composition layers.
brand_law.motion_language: Measured camera pushes, line draws, mask reveals, focus pulls, and structural assembly. Indigo represents evidence or a supported route, never magic energy. Use hard cuts only for evidence contrasts; otherwise use 0.3-0.6 second paper wipes, focus pulls, or velocity-matched pushes.

common_output_spec.safe_area: Keep deterministic text inside 8% title-safe margins.
common_output_spec.accessibility: Essential spoken claims also appear as deterministic captions; never rely on color alone.

global_claims_policy: Every numeric claim must map to a named evidence source in the film record.
Keep panel size, model count, engine, chemistry family, and draft/review status visible whenever they materially bound a claim.
Use measured, reported, proposed, targeted, or contingent language as appropriate; never upgrade a model result or target into deployed fact.
A film using a Draft or FOR EDITOR REVIEW source requires factual and editorial clearance before external publication.
Source artwork is illustrative evidence language, not independent proof.

films.title: The Union Verdict
films.truthful_thesis: On the recorded Z1 same-engine campaign, four guidance models shared a union of DFT anchors, reducing duplicated evaluations while revealing a real split in guidance quality; this is a bounded campaign result, not proof of general transfer or deployment.

source_articles.use: Primary campaign verdict, economics, failures, and caveats; external publication requires clearance.
Supporting earlier union-anchor economics; do not substitute its 558-to-154 baseline for the later executed 430-to-129 result.

excluded_source_assets.reason: Batch QA reported people in the generated image.

shots.on_screen: Four model-specific indigo traces converge only at shared anchors. Deterministic title: Four models. One evidence bill.
shots.motion: Slow camera push; traces draw from separate edges and lock with restrained mechanical snaps.

shots.on_screen: Four duplicated lanes assemble as deterministic dots, then a union lane appears. Caption the recorded baseline as 430 naive evaluations.
shots.motion: Dots step on in rows; the union lane waits until duplication is legible.

shots.on_screen: Four lanes fold into one ribbon. Counters resolve to 129 executed anchors and 70% fewer DFT evaluations, qualified as the recorded campaign.
shots.motion: Paths pull into one indigo spine; omitted work fades to untouched paper.

shots.on_screen: Deterministic ledger: 129/129 anchors evaluated, zero evaluation failures, 61.0 wall-hours, $14.65 cloud-equivalent; all four met the same-engine strong-win gate.
shots.motion: Rules draw and values type on once; no celebratory badges.

shots.on_screen: Two guidance models meet the true extrema; two miss saddles on some paths and record a 6.8 meV deficit. A thin ochre rule marks the caveat.
shots.motion: Matched pairs align; undercovered gauges stop visibly short.

shots.on_screen: Models guide. DFT measures. Proof keeps the score. Footer: one chemistry family; one engine; short-path sparsity not stress-tested.
shots.motion: Camera settles; the next route draws only halfway to signal open work.

allowed: 430 naive evaluations versus 129 union anchors; 70% fewer; 3.33x on the recorded campaign.
129/129 evaluated; zero evaluation failures; 61.0 wall-hours; $14.65 cloud-equivalent.
All four models met the same-engine strong-win gate; two exact-extrema results and two 6.8 meV undercoverage deficits.
must_disclose: Primary article is FOR EDITOR REVIEW and not cleared for external citation.
One panel, one Li-migration chemistry family, one engine, one functional; seven large paths deferred.
On five-to-seven-image paths, sparse extension is nearly dense by construction.
forbidden: Universal transfer, production readiness, solved solid-state batteries, or general DFT replacement.
Conflating the earlier 558-to-154 estimate with the executed 430-to-129 campaign.

films.title: The Savings Stack
films.truthful_thesis: Seven families of compute-saving methods reduce different kinds of work, while shared anchors and a theorem commons can reduce duplicated evaluation and make limits reusable; the measured economics are panel-specific and the layers must not be multiplied as independent without qualification.

source_articles.use: Primary release summary, seven-layer taxonomy, union economics, and evidence status.

shots.on_screen: One costly evaluation pulse crosses an empty paper field. Deterministic title: The expensive part is the call.
shots.motion: One indigo pulse crosses fine ink infrastructure.

shots.on_screen: Seven plates assemble: surrogate search, active learning, multi-fidelity, abstention, faster DFT, electronic surrogates, path and sampling algorithms. Deterministic captions name each bounded role.
shots.motion: Each plate enters from a distinct edge and locks to a shared spine.

shots.on_screen: The gaps align into one void. Caption: Signals are not certificates.
shots.motion: Plates stop; only the shared void expands.

shots.on_screen: Shared anchor stations connect four routes. Deterministic figures: 558 naive, 154 union, 72.4% fewer, 3.62x on 29 analyzable Z1 paths; four-model union cost is about 10% above one-model union on this curve.
shots.motion: Routes merge at existing stations; counts move only after the denominator appears.

shots.on_screen: An open rack feeds independent test bays. Close: Reuse the evidence. Keep the limits. Footer: one panel, four models, one engine, one chemistry family; not peer reviewed.
shots.motion: Evidence cartridges slide outward; camera ends on the wider system.

allowed: On 29 analyzable Z1 paths, 558 naive anchors versus 154 union anchors equals 72.4% fewer and 3.62x.
The recorded union curve rises from 139.5 to 154 as models go from one to four, approximately 10%, while naive cost rises to 558.
The v1 audit resolved 115/115 arXiv and 48/48 DOI identifiers.
must_disclose: Path 14 failed CI-NEB convergence, making 29 the denominator.
No new DFT was run for the booklet analysis.
Hashable research release, not peer review; identifier checks do not upgrade abstract-only evidence.
Multiplicative stacking is derived, not measured, unless explicitly labeled.
forbidden: Universal 72.4% savings, guaranteed accuracy, zero-cost validation, or independent multiplicative savings.
Implying that the commons replaces experiments or exposes proprietary chemistry.

films.title: The Trust Layer
films.truthful_thesis: Computational materials discovery can generate and simulate candidates faster than laboratories can validate them; a correction-and-verification layer is valuable when it exposes evidence boundaries, routes unsupported cases to measurement or abstention, and never turns confidence into proof.

source_articles.use: Primary bottleneck framing; quantitative and partnership claims require review.
Supporting correction, anchor, and abstention boundary language.

excluded_source_assets.reason: Batch QA reported probable baked microtext.
Batch QA reported probable baked microtext; do not use until cleared.

shots.on_screen: Many faint candidates approach a load-bearing bridge. Deterministic question: Believable enough to try?
shots.motion: Candidates drift quickly; bridge joints remain precise.

shots.on_screen: Generation and simulation lanes widen while physical validation stays narrow. Title: Belief is the bottleneck.
shots.motion: Upstream lanes accelerate; validation advances at constant speed.

shots.on_screen: Deterministic gates label three routes: CORRECT where licensed, ANCHOR where reference calculation is required, ABSTAIN where evidence is absent. Caption: A referee, not a confidence score.
shots.motion: Supported paths pass, anchor paths divert, unsupported paths stop with a small ochre marker.

shots.on_screen: Instrument bays represent model builders receiving external verification, laboratories receiving characterized shortlists, and formal methods binding claims to records. Do not name uncontracted partners.
shots.motion: Evidence lines lock only after passing a gate.

shots.on_screen: Evidence, proofs, benchmark data, and decisions form an inspectable loop beneath practical infrastructure. Close: Checked once. Built on with its limits.
shots.motion: The measured return path completes; infrastructure settles onto a thin indigo foundation.
shots.transition: End on paper with boundary visible.

allowed: Candidate generation and cheap prediction have expanded faster than independent synthesis and validation capacity.
The proposed layer measures error, corrects only within supported domains, and binds claims to evidence.
Correction, reference anchoring, and abstention are distinct evidence routes.
must_disclose: Primary investment article is Draft; market, novelty, partner, budget, and climate claims require review.
Industrial partners are targeted, not contracted, absent a newer signed record.
fcc results do not establish transfer to other material families.
A theorem proves its formal statement against inputs, not experimental truth.
forbidden: Unique, universally accurate, commercially deployed, or guaranteed timeline claims.
Equating confidence with proof or prediction with synthesis.
Using excluded baked-microtext assets before clearance.

films.title: An Order of Effort
films.truthful_thesis: Materials observables form a measured ladder of difficulty, and each rung licenses a different response—correction, bounded use, reference anchoring, on-policy work, or abstention—so research effort should climb only as far as evidence allows.

source_articles.use: Primary seven-tier ladder, measured results, boundary rule, and current rounds.

excluded_source_assets.reason: Batch QA reported probable baked microtext.

shots.on_screen: A seven-rung ladder rises from regular bulk structure toward unresolved states. Title: Do the easiest honest work first.
shots.motion: Camera tilts upward; lower rungs assemble while upper rungs remain faint.

shots.on_screen: Reveal in order: statics; elastic response; surface energies; defect formation; transition-state barriers; interface adsorption; magnetic and excited-state properties. Pair each with its evidence-licensed response.
shots.motion: Each rung draws, its test geometry assembles, and its route locks or stops.

shots.on_screen: Nested rings become a theorem rail. Caption: No correction family acts outside its proved domain.
shots.motion: Rail snaps into place; mismatched routes stop without failure spectacle.

shots.on_screen: Tier 1 marks easy-first runtime correction; Tier 5 marks model-guided sparse DFT. Other tiers remain bounded, on-policy, or abstention work.
shots.motion: Two indigo bays brighten; uncertainty widens toward the hard end; ochre only at abstention.

shots.on_screen: Near-term corrections and frontier measurements balance in one portfolio. Close: Measured trust. Machine-checked limits. Priced accuracy.
shots.motion: Portfolio settles without a universal-law or all-green state.

allowed: Seven ordered tiers from statics through magnetic and excited-state properties.
Reported statics corrections reduced lattice-constant errors from 1.60% to 0.33% and 1.75% to 0.74% in the cited round.
A reported surface example reduced one facet error from 9.7% to 1.5% at approximately 15% runtime overhead.
For barriers, model geometry can guide while energy levels require sparse reference anchors.
must_disclose: Tiers describe evidence and strategy, not universal technology readiness.
Elastic-response kill condition fired; defect and interface tiers remain scoped; magnetic and excited states are abstention domains in current models.
Easy-first and sparse-DFT rounds are bounded programs.
forbidden: A single correction law covers all matter or all tiers.
Approximate 10x DFT savings as a universal guarantee.
Using B6-A02-02 before baked-text clearance.

films.title: Materials in Society
films.truthful_thesis: Climate and energy outcomes depend on materials surviving real operating conditions, so the responsible story follows candidates through correction, proof, synthesis, device testing, and scale-up before it shows societal infrastructure.

source_articles.use: Primary evidence for the Z1 battery-material panel, migration barriers, provenance, and limits.
Portfolio framing; impact, target, transfer, and partnership claims require review.

shots.on_screen: Storage, air-capture, ammonia, and solar infrastructure appears before atomic detail. Title: Between a model and an outcome: a material that survives the world.
shots.motion: Wide lateral move; one verification line connects systems without implying deployment.

shots.on_screen: A solid-state cell reveals the electrolyte bridge; test specimens remain visible beside storage infrastructure. Caption: Barriers decide whether a candidate conducts—or only looks promising in a model.
shots.motion: An indigo ion route climbs a restrained barrier into a practical cell; no guaranteed transformation.

shots.on_screen: A sorbent panel sits inside a modular DAC contactor. Caption: Capacity is not enough; humidity stability and makeability still decide usefulness.
shots.motion: Sparse airflow passes through the contactor; a portion continues to a test cartridge.

shots.on_screen: An ammonia reactor connects to renewable power and fertilizer infrastructure only as a proposed pathway. Caption: Catalysts must be active, selective, stable, and verified.
shots.motion: Reactor zones assemble; indigo highlights only measured interfaces and a pilot handoff.

shots.on_screen: A lead-free absorber module remains beside a durability chamber. Caption: Safer chemistry matters only if efficiency, stability, and scale-up survive together.
shots.motion: Module remains partly inside the test bay; no completed solar-city transformation.

shots.on_screen: Five streams pass through correction, proof boundary, partner synthesis, device validation, and scale-up. Close: Not a prediction. A credible next experiment. Footer names all contingencies.
shots.motion: Only the next experiment enters an active bay; downstream infrastructure remains lightly drawn.
shots.transition: End on paper with chain visible.

allowed: Final Z1 article describes 42 published Li-ion electrolyte chemistries: 30 frozen test and 12 disjoint training chemistries.
Test-panel DFT-NEB reference barriers span 0.068 eV to 3.25 eV and are computed, not experimental.
Draft portfolio targets are cobalt-free cathodes, halide solid electrolytes, MOF sorbents, ammonia catalysts, and lead-free perovskites.
Every societal pathway remains contingent on synthesis, characterization, device validation, scale-up, and deployment.
must_disclose: Five-material article is Draft; its 5-12 GtCO2/year aggregate, performance targets, transfer, partner, and market claims are not approved film headlines.
Z1 barriers are computed references, not device outcomes.
Target materials do not yet exist at the required combination of scale, performance, durability, and price.
Infrastructure scenes are plausible pathways, not program-produced deployments.
forbidden: Claiming 5-12 GtCO2/year unlocked, any target solved, or systems deployed.
Safer, denser, cheaper, clean, or climate-scale outcomes stated as achieved.
Naming labs or companies as contracted partners without a current signed record.
